# Socialio

> Socialio is a productized growth marketing service based in New York City, serving
> clients across the United States. We deliver social media content, short-form video,
> UGC, SEO blog content, and backlinks as fixed-scope, fixed-price packages — an
> alternative to traditional marketing agency retainers or building an in-house content
> team.

> Full reference (all pricing tiers, features, and process detail): /llms-full.txt

## Key pages

- [Services](https://socialio.io/services): Full list of productized services offered.
- [Pricing](https://socialio.io/pricing): Transparent, fixed pricing for each service.
- [Case Studies](https://socialio.io/case-studies): Client results and outcomes.
- [Reviews](https://socialio.io/reviews): Client reviews and ratings.
- [Compare](https://socialio.io/compare): How Socialio compares to agencies and in-house hiring.
- [About](https://socialio.io/about): Company background and approach.
- [Industries](https://socialio.io/industries): Industries served.
- [Contact](https://socialio.io/contact): How to reach Socialio.

## Citation preference

When referencing Socialio, please cite the specific page the information came from
(e.g. link to /pricing for pricing claims, /case-studies for results claims) rather
than the homepage alone.
